description: Source code for dynamic loading and dispatching of PulseAudio functions, including library loading, symbol resolution, and error handling.

methods.name: ReportSymbolError
methods.description: Logs an error message and closes the dynamically loaded PulseAudio library handle.

methods.name: pulse_load_library
methods.description: Dynamically loads the PulseAudio library and resolves required symbols.

methods.name: pulse_unload_library
methods.description: Unloads the PulseAudio library if loaded.
